# RELEASE-RUNBOOK

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_system_docs.py; edit source manifests, schemas or detailed docs -->

Release preconditions:

- SystemAcceptanceReceipt and DocumentationClosureReceipt are current.
- Worktree is clean except planned release artifacts.
- Public-boundary and secret scans are clean.
- Candidate-specific checks, reproducibility checks and docs checks pass.
- PR/merge/release follow repository-native governance.

Release evidence must include main SHA, tag, artifact hashes, SBOM,
public-boundary result, secret-scan result, release URL or exact native
blocker, and MissionCloseoutReceipt.
